item.title:
Dahil umaasa, I've made 3 phone calls this morning with different reps. Bakit 3 reps pa kailangan? Kasi para ma-address ang confusion/s nating lahat or most of us.
Confirmed na hindi po "SYSTEM ISSUE OR UPDATE" The fact is binabago ni RCBC Credit ang re-availment sa Payday Now at Salary Loan offers unlike before (for how many years) kahit walang SMS or EMAIL ay makaka-avail sa offers. FOR PRE-QUALIFICATIONS na sila this time.
Yung Payday Now at Salary Loan offers na nag-reflect sa app pero di makapag proceed kasi 0.00; it only MEANS na wala pang AMOUNT available offer to re-avail.
Now, nasa inyo na kung aasa pa kayo o hindi. Pero AKO? Hindi na ako aasa kasi tinitingnan ko din ang part na wala ng auto deduct every sahod at feeling ko baka mas paunti-unti kong matutuhan ang pag-handle ng finances ko in the long run. ❤️

item.title:
Gusto Mong Mag-Avail ng SSS LoanLite? Ganito ang Diskarte! 💙
Pwede nang mag-apply at makuha ang iyong SSS LoanLite diretso sa DiskarTech account!
Easy lang mag-apply: 1️⃣ I-open ang RCBC DiskarTech app at tap SSS LoanLite. Ilagay ang iyong SSS number at employment details. 2️⃣ Tap Apply Now. If qualified, piliin ang loan amount at payment term na swak sa’yo. 3️⃣ Complete the required details, review the loan agreements, then confirm your application.
Kapag successful ang availment, diretso sa iyong DiskarTech account ang net loan proceeds.
Ang bagong diskarte sa loan. Apply na sa RCBC DiskarTech app! 💙
Loan approval, amount, and terms are subject to SSS eligibility and applicable terms and conditions.
#SSSLoanLite #SSS #RCBCDiskarTech #BagongDiskarteSaLoan

item.title:
Hi Bank of Makati and Motortrade,
Mag ra-rant lang ako kasi nakakagago na yung ilang buwan kong pag iintay sa OR/CR ko.
June 2021 ko nung nakuha motor ko and November 2024 ko po ata natapos syang hulugan. (Hindi ako mayaman eh kaya hulugan). Hindi ko naasikaso ang pag kuha ko ng OR/CR kaya April, 2026 ko na sya nai file for claiming. Sabe ng Clerk nyo 2-3 months yung process-Grabeng tagal para sa unit na bayad na. October 2026 na wala pa din. Kelan po kaya ito pwedeng asikasuhin
Ang sa akin lang po to ease the burden sa pagkuha ng OR/CR bakit di kayo mag process non once na mafull yung bayad sa inyo? Diba? Customer satisfaction yun. Hindi yung pag di namin na asikaso pending sin sa inyo. Aba, perfect talaga. Pero wala naman akong magagawa kung yun ang process nyo.
Tag ko na din po si Land Transportation Office - Philippines Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board - LTFRB Department of Trade and Industry baka sakaling mapabilis ang workaround
Thank you.

item.title:
⚠️ AWARENESS POST: PLEASE BE CAREFUL WITH UNEXPECTED BANK CALLS
Earlier today, I received a phone call from someone claiming to be a representative of RCBC Bank. The caller knew my complete name, including my middle name, and even mentioned the full 16-digit number of my credit card. Because of this, I initially thought the call was legitimate.
The caller offered me an RCBC cash loan with a stated interest rate of only 0.39% and offered to guide me through the application process using my RCBC Pulz app.
I was also told that I had two options: visit the bank in person and bring my card, or complete the transaction on the same day.
As a business owner who regularly manages and reinvests money, the offer sounded very tempting, and I almost considered proceeding.
However, I became suspicious when the caller claimed that an account number had already been generated under my name, JOY CALVELO. The caller then instructed me to open my RCBC Pulz app and navigate to the UNLIPAY feature and the caller provided an account number where I was instructed to transfer ₱100,000, but the account name was still under JOY CALVELO.
At that point, I decided to question the caller about the account number and asked why one had been generated when I had not opened an account. I also asked whether the call was legitimate. The caller ended the call shortly afterward.
📌 A REMINDER TO EVERYONE:
• Be cautious when receiving unexpected calls offering loans or other financial products. • Do not assume a caller is legitimate simply because they know your name or credit card details. • Avoid following instructions or authorizing transactions through your banking app until you have verified the offer directly with your bank.
I am sharing this experience for awareness and precaution, so others can be more careful when receiving similar calls.
Stay alert, verify first, and protect your hard-earned money. 🙏
#ScamAwareness #OnlineSafety #BankingSafety #StayVigilant

item.title:
Hello po, Ask lang sana ako ng advice regarding sa nangyari sa RCBC Hexagon credit card ko.
Last night, may dalawang UnliPay transactions sa card ko, ₱50k each, so ₱100k total. Hindi ko ginagamit yung phone ko, wala akong ginawang transaction, and I never shared my OTP with anyone.
I received OTP messages, followed by approval SMS for both transactions. When I tried to log in sa RCBC Pulz app ko, hindi na ako makapasok. I had to reset my password, and doon ko nakita na pending yung dalawang ₱50k UnliPay transactions.
I immediately called RCBC to report the incident and have my card blocked. May case number na rin ako, and they asked me to submit screenshots of the OTP and approval messages, plus a valid ID.
My concern is, possible ba talagang mangyari ito kahit hindi mo naman shinare yung OTP? And if RCBC says na legitimate yung transactions because OTP was used and the transactions were approved, may chance pa rin ba na ma-reverse yung charges since I didn't authorize them?
I'm really worried kasi ₱100k is a huge amount, and I honestly have no idea how this happened.
For those who experienced something similar, especially with RCBC or UnliPay, ano po yung naging process ng dispute ninyo?
Would appreciate any advice on what steps I should take next. Should I file a police/cybercrime report and escalate to BSP as well?
Thank you so much! 🙏

item.title:
Hindi pala ako nag-iisa na umaasa sa Payday Loan ngayon. 🥹
Yung tipong nakapag-set ka na ng date kung kailan mo mababayaran ang mga bills at obligations mo kasi umaasa kang papasok na ang loan mo. Tapos biglang nagkaroon ng error, kaya ayun, nganga muna tayo. 😭
Sana maging okay na bukas para makapag-proceed na ang loan natin at mabayaran na natin ang mga dapat bayaran. 🙏🏻
Sa mga kapwa ko RCBC members na naghihintay din, kamusta kayo? May update na ba sa inyo?
And sa mga nagsasabing huwag umasa sa Payday Loan at kung ano mang loans, sana maintindihan din natin na hindi pare-pareho ang sitwasyon ng bawat tao. Hindi lahat sapat ang kinikita para ma-cover ang lahat ng gastusin at obligations. May mga taong maayos namang nagba-budget at nagpa-plano ng kanilang finances, pero may mga pagkakataong kailangan talaga ng kaunting tulong para maitawid ang mga bayarin.
Hindi naman ibig sabihin na umaasa ka sa loan ay hindi ka na marunong humawak ng pera. Minsan, may mga responsibilities lang talaga tayong kailangang unahin.
Konting empathy naman sana. Hindi natin alam ang pinagdadaanan ng bawat isa, kaya sana imbes na manghusga o mang-bash, piliin nating umunawa.
Praying na maayos na ang system bukas para sa ating lahat na naghihintay. Hindi lang pera ang hinihintay natin, kundi pati ang pagkakataong matupad ang mga obligasyong nakatoka sa atin. 🙏🏻🥹

And sa mga nagsasabing huwag umasa sa Payday Loan at kung ano mang loans, sana maintindihan din natin na hindi pare-pareho ang sitwasyon ng bawat tao. Hindi lahat sapat ang kinikita para ma-cover ang lahat ng gastusin at obligations. May mga taong maayos namang nagba-budget at nagpa-plano ng kanilang finances, pero may mga pagkakataong kailangan talaga ng kaunting tulong para maitawid ang mga bayarin.
Hindi naman ibig sabihin na umaasa ka sa loan ay hindi ka na marunong humawak ng pera. Minsan, may mga responsibilities lang talaga tayong kailangang unahin.
Konting empathy naman sana. Hindi natin alam ang pinagdadaanan ng bawat isa, kaya sana imbes na manghusga o mang-bash, piliin nating umunawa.
Praying na maayos na ang system bukas para sa ating lahat na naghihintay. Hindi lang pera ang hinihintay natin, kundi pati ang pagkakataong matupad ang mga obligasyong nakatoka sa atin. 🙏🏻🥹

item.title:
Kaya nagka-problem yung Payday NOW, hindi dahil nagsara si RCBC, pero combination ng 3 bagay — kaya nag-sabay sabay yung mga screenshot na naka "on break" at "0.00":
Biglang dami ng umuutang Sabi mismo ni RCBC sa award nila, dumoble yung payroll loan book nila from 2024 to 2025, at umabot na ng mahigit ₱1 Billion per month yung pinapautang nila ngayong 2026. Tapos 65% na ng lahat ng bagong pautang nila galing na sa Payday NOW / Salary Loan NOW. So overloaded yung system.
Naghigpit sila sa pautang May problema kasi sila sa mga hindi nakakabayad — umakyat NPL (non-performing loan) ratio nila to 4.8%. Kaya sabi ng CEO nila na si Cariaso, naghigpit sila: binawasan credit line ng mga high-risk borrowers, at naglagay ng parang early warning program para sa auto at housing loan. Kaya yung mga dati auto-approved, biglang nawala offer o naging 0.00 muna habang ni-re-evaluate.
Sunod-sunod na system maintenance Nag-announce sila ng maintenance na kasama talaga Payday NOW sa mga naka-offline — tulad nung April 26 at iba pa. Pag ganyan, ang lumalabas talaga sa Pulz app ay yung pop-up na nakita mo: "service is currently on break" at lahat 0.00.
So hindi totally sira — sinadya nilang i-pause para: ayusin system dahil sa dami ng users linisin yung list ng mga qualified (para bumaba bad loans) mag-update ng app
Kaya yung mga nasa FB na nag-rant na "kaltas na pero wala pa offer 1 week" — natapat sila sa maintenance + re-qualification period.
Ngayon pabalik na ulit yan paunti-unti. Usually after 2-3 banking days after sahod mo at posted na payment mo, bumabalik na yung offer.

item.title: Realization ko sa issue ngayon sa RCBC PayDay Now. Hindi ma sya yung dating reliable source na mapag kukunan mo ng pera once na ma deduct nila yung outstanding balance sa payroll mo. For 3 years nasanay ako na 2 to 3 days after may offer na sila at ma solve muna pangangailangan mo. Simula nitong pag pasok ng October di na ganun. Madalas may isyu pa like 7k lang bayaran mo kinuha nila 14k. Tapos ibabalik after ilang oras na kung iisipin ang hassle kasi ineexpect mo may matitira sayo kasi yun lang nmn utang mo. May mag comment n nmn jan " Bakit kasi naka depende kayo sa loan eme eme. Eh di ikaw na di nakaranas magipit at kumapit sa loan pinagpala ka ehh". Wala lang naghinga lang saloobin. Respect.

item.title:
Loan Lite with existing salary loan possible Sharing my Experience
Makaka-loan ba ng Loan Lite kahit may Salary loan o Emergency loan? Yes po, if may past due settle mo muna.
Tips on applying sa Loan Lite:
Wag mag apply ng madaling araw. Kasi madalas system error, 5-6 days marereset.
Best time to apply, 10-11am.
Make sure na yung number at email mo ay naa-access mo pa, if not asikasohin muna to change it.
May salary loan, may emergency loan na parehong November amortization pero nakatagos naman ako sa loan lite with 19k offer.
Make sure na kaya bayaran, para hindi sarap now hirap next time hehe.

item.title:
₱40 BILLION SSS LOANLITE BUDGET, PERO NASAAN ANG ACCOUNTABILITY? NAKAKAGALIT Nakakagalit at nakakadismaya with SSS LoanLite and digital financial services, why are customers still struggling to get basic customer support from apps like UnionDigital and DiskarTech?
I have been waiting for almost two months for DiskarTech to change my registered mobile number, despite complying with their final requirements. Meanwhile, my UnionDigital verification has been pending for over a month. Emails and inquiries are difficult to get responses to, and customers are left waiting without clear updates or timely solutions.
A digital banking app is useless if customers cannot access their accounts, complete transactions, or get assistance when problems arise. Customer service is not optional. It is a basic responsibility of any financial institution handling people’s money.
If public funds are being allocated to support these digital financial services, the public deserves transparency, accountability, and services that actually work. Budget allocation alone means nothing if the systems remain inefficient and customers are left dealing with unresolved concerns.
Why are customers forced to repeatedly follow up just to get simple issues resolved? Why is it so difficult to reach customer service? And why do these problems continue despite numerous negative customer feedback and complaints?
Please do your job better. Customers deserve more than automated responses, unanswered emails, and endless waiting. We deserve reliable service, clear communication, and accountability.
I hope the SSS, the relevant regulators, and the management of these digital financial institutions take these concerns seriously and investigate the recurring service issues.
Public trust must be earned through actual service—not just promises, apps, or big budget figures.

item.title:
NABAWASAN ANG MARIBANK ACCOUNT MO PERO WALANG LUMABAS NA PERA SA ATM? MABABAWI PA BA?
SO, HETO NA NGAAAA. HAHAHAHA
Imagine, nag-withdraw ka ng 5k gamit ang MariBank Debit Card mo. Nag-process ang ATM, naghintay ka, pero walang lumabas na pera. Tapos pag-check mo sa MariBank app, nabawasan na pala ang savings balance mo.
Ang ending, wala ka nang cash, nabawasan pa ang account mo. Parang nag-donate ka sa ATM nang hindi mo alam. HAHAHAHA
Pero wait. Kapag failed ang ATM withdrawal pero nabawasan ang MariBank Savings Account mo, posible pa bang maibalik ang pera?
YES, possible! Puwede mong i-report at ipa-investigate ang transaction. Kung makumpirmang walang cash na na-dispense at mali ang deduction, maaaring ma-reverse ang amount.
PERO hindi automatic o guaranteed ang refund. Depende pa rin ito sa resulta ng investigation.
At hindi lang ito sa MariBank puwedeng mangyari. Possible rin sa ibang banks kapag nagkaroon ng ATM malfunction, cash dispenser error, o communication problem sa banking network.
🤔 SO, ANO ANG DAPAT GAWIN KAPAG NANGYARI ITO SA IYO?
FIRST. Huwag munang paulit-ulit mag-withdraw sa parehong ATM. Siguraduhing tapos na ang transaction at nakuha mo ang debit card mo.
SECOND. I-check ang MariBank transaction history at i-save ang importanteng details.
✅ Date at exact time ng withdrawal ✅ Amount na nabawas sa account ✅ Pangalan at location ng ATM bank ✅ ATM receipt, kung mayroon ✅ Screenshot ng deduction sa MariBank app ✅ Transaction reference number o ATM machine ID, kung available
THIRD. I-report agad sa MariBank Customer Service.
Kahit BDO, BPI, RCBC, Metrobank, o ibang bank ang may-ari ng ATM, puwede kang magsimula sa MariBank dahil MariBank Debit Card ang ginamit mo.
Ito ang official contact channels.
MariBank App Me → Chat with MariBank
Customer Service Hotline (+632) 8424 8050
Humingi ng case reference number at itanong kung kailangan mong mag-submit ng formal dispute form o supporting documents.
🤔 PAANO KUNG KAILANGAN MONG MAG-SEND NG WRITTEN COMPLAINT?
Ito ang sample message na puwede mong i-copy at i-edit para sa official MariBank support channel.
Subject: Failed ATM Withdrawal - Account Debited but No Cash Dispensed
Good day, MariBank Customer Support.
I would like to report a failed ATM withdrawal using my MariBank Debit Card.
Transaction Date: Transaction Time: Withdrawal Amount: ATM Bank/Operator: ATM Location: Transaction Reference Number (if available):
My MariBank Savings Account was debited for the withdrawal amount, but the ATM did not dispense any cash.
I would like to request an investigation and reversal of the disputed amount if the transaction is confirmed unsuccessful, including any related withdrawal fee, if applicable.
Please advise if I need to submit a formal dispute form or additional supporting documents.
Kindly provide a case reference number, information about any applicable dispute fees, and an estimated resolution timeline.
Thank you for your assistance.
AYAN. HAHAHAHA
At least hindi mo na kailangang mangapa kung ano ang sasabihin kapag nangyari ito sa iyo.
🤔 GAANO KATAGAL BAGO MAIBALIK ANG PERA?
Depende sa transaction at investigation. May failed transactions na maaaring maayos matapos ang reconciliation, habang ang iba ay nangangailangan ng formal dispute investigation.
Ayon sa MariBank Help Center, ang card disputes ay dapat i-file within 60 calendar days mula sa transaction date.
Pero PLEASE, huwag nang hintayin ang 60th day. May iba pang provisions sa bank's Terms of Service tungkol sa transaction records, kaya mas mabuting i-report agad at kumpirmahin ang applicable requirements.
At hindi rin guaranteed na babalik ang pera within 24 hours o 3 days. Humingi ng estimated resolution timeline para sa specific case mo.
😱 MAY BAYAD BA ANG PAG-FILE NG DISPUTE?
May published na ₱250 Dispute and Chargeback Service Fee ang MariBank.
PERO hindi malinaw sa publicly available information kung applicable ito sa bawat failed ATM withdrawal na walang lumabas na cash.
Kaya itanong muna sa customer service kung may applicable fee sa complaint mo.
😭 PAANO KUNG HINDI NA-RESOLVE NG MARIBANK ANG PROBLEMA?
Kung na-report mo na sa MariBank at hindi ka satisfied sa naging response o hindi maayos ang pag-handle sa complaint, puwede mo itong i-escalate sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas.
Visit www.bsp.gov.ph at gamitin ang BSP Online Buddy o BOB.
Ihanda ang complaint reference number, screenshots, at previous communications mo sa MariBank.
At reminder lang, huwag ibigay ang OTP, ATM PIN, password, o Secure PIN kahit kanino.
SO AYUN. HAHAHAHA
Hindi porket nabawasan ang MariBank account mo at walang lumabas na pera sa ATM, ibig sabihin goodbye money na agad. May proseso para ma-investigate at posibleng ma-reverse ang failed ATM withdrawal.
Ang importante, nai-report mo agad, may supporting details ka, at may case reference number para sa follow-up.
Share ko lang kasi baka may maka-experience nito at hindi alam kung saan magsisimula.
KAYO BA? MAY NAKA-EXPERIENCE NA BA NG FAILED ATM WITHDRAWAL GAMIT ANG MARIBANK DEBIT CARD O IBANG BANK?
Saang ATM bank nangyari at ilang araw bago na-resolve? Share your experience para may idea rin ang ibang readers. Huwag lang mag-post ng personal banking details. HAHAHAHA

item.title:
I don’t know what’s happening with RCBC at the moment
Sobrang ingat ko with my cards, biometrics, covered the sensitive info at the back, i dont let people touch my card, i rarely transact online, and I do not click links. I worked in banks before kaya maingat talaga ako.
Recently, I got a call from someone pretending to be from RCBC - itataas daw credit limit ko to 250k (already sounded like a scam since my current limit is above 1.5M). The guy knew all my details - mailing address, card number, card expiry date, even put me on hold and played the RCBC music in the background.
I ended the call and immediately called the hotline, wala daw ganun na number from their marketing team. Sobrang hassle, had to cut the card, de-link all cards AND deposits from my pulz account, then delete pulz altogether. Needed to wait for a replacement card before I can make another pulz account.
3 days after, I got another call, if everything was ok daw ba with my credit card (syempre na cut ko na and wala na yung PULZ account so baka nakita din nila yun), I just dropped the call.
Most of my transactions are with RCBC, and in all my years being with them, ngayon lang to nangyari. I hope the security improves or mahuli kung sino man gumagawa nung inside job.

item.title:
I applied for an SSS card February this year, I waited for a couple of months for my card to be released, (complaint emails, and update has been sent to them during this time. For them to atleast do something or expedite the process a lil bit) but they refunded me the Php200 that I paid for by July, Imagine waiting for 5 months for nothing and then I red some applications (on threads) that they receive their cards after 2weeks?? So I brushed it off and apply for a new card on the same month again! *Fast forward* So I receive this text message and email that my card was ready for pick up and when I came to the branch on where I supposed to get my card, they told me that they didn't have it. And it might be a lost card already!!
Like? WTFUU?? they ask me if I have my Pin, which I did not recieve and I dont know why.
They took my number telling me that they'll message me within the day, and here I am ranting coz there's No update at all!! Napaka Poorservice ng RCBC, Have you experience the same thing?

item.title:
Finally! I have my own Valid Id. Dili nako kulurom 😂 kung pangitaan kog valid id naa nakoy ika kuot aw😁
1st of all dapat updated imong Acc sa sss specially active imong contact #. kung wala pa fill ap kag eform ipa update sa sss branch.
📌 HOW TO APPLY SSS ID ONLINE (via RCBC DiskarTech):
1️⃣ Log in sa My.SSS account 2️⃣ Go to Services > My SSS Card 3️⃣ Fill in details & choose RCBC DiskarTech 4️⃣ Copy your SSS Transaction Number 5️⃣ Download the RCBC DiskarTech app 6️⃣ Tap SSS Member 7️⃣ Enter your SSS details 8️⃣ Complete verification 9️⃣ Go to Cards tab - choose the nearest RCBC in your area. paghuman nimog apply, e monitor lang imong RCBC DiskarTech app kung kanus a available ang card nimo, and then mag send pud na sila sa imong default PIN..
wala ra gyud bulan naabot na dayon😄pero wala ko mag expect na ang nawng nako kay matic kadtong nawng nako sa national id. 😂😂 pero mas pinakadali daw ang AUB bank.

item.title:
🚨 SCAM ALERT, KA-DISKARTECH! 🚨
Mag-ingat sa mga kumakalat na unofficial customer support email addresses online!
Para iwas scam at mas mabilis na ma-address ang inyong concerns, siguraduhing sa official support channels lamang makipag-ugnayan. 💙
📩 DiskarTech Customer Care help@diskartech.ph Para sa app, account, at transaction concerns.
📩 SSS LoanLite Help Desk helpsssloanlite@diskartech.ph Para sa SSS LoanLite-related concerns.
📩 SSS Help Desk usssaptayo@sss.gov.ph Para sa SSS membership, contributions, eligibility, at iba pang SSS-related concerns.
📞 SSS Hotline: 1455
🔒 Reminder, Ka-DiskarTech! Huwag ibahagi ang iyong OTP, MPIN, password, o iba pang sensitive account information kaninuman.
Huwag basta maniwala o mag-share ng unverified contact information. Always check the official RCBC DiskarTech and SSS channels para siguradong legit ang kausap mo!
Iwas scam, safe ang diskarte! 💙
#RCBCDiskarTech #ScamAlert #IwasScam #SafeAngDiskarte

So I tried. Total cashback ₱9000 Eastwest Visa- 3k worth of groceries (lagi naman nag gogrocery, kasi need naman) so ang cash back? Ibili natin ng bigas, coz why not? May pangkain na kami for a month😅

Maya Visa (mine)- our altis is due na din for change oil, need renewal sept din. Wala pa yung cash back that time so di na nagamit yung pera pang pa renew. Might as well ilagay ang 1500 na cashback sa gas allowance.

Di pa nacredit yung cash back since sept 27 ko kasi nagamit Spend 3k sa Maya Debit for internet bills Spend 3k Palawan Pay sa kuryente

Isipin mo? Lahat ng gastos sa monthly necessities may cash back? May balik? , and i will be using the CB for other expenses din. Laking help!
Salamat VISA, salamat google pay🤍😊😅

item.title: Ano bato rcbc 3 days na ganiyan Anong balak niyo I cancel niyo nalang I rejected or anything Hindi Yung naka pending kami ng ganiyan. Yung mga kaka apply lang nauna pang Maka recieve dapat nga na recieve nayan kasi na bigay ko Yung last na otp para sa pag disbursed Nung amount. Hinold niyo pa sabog na Yung email ng bsp saken kaka complaint Wala naman makausap na maayos sa email niyo same sa call kung Kani kanino niyo pinapasa kesyo Hindi pa na lulunch Wala pang official date eh bat andami ng naka avail kalokohan niyo. Tangalin niyo sa dikartech account ko yang on going process kung Wala naman kayong balak na I release Yan.

item.title:
🚨 SCAM AWARENESS: RCBC, RCBC Credit
Sharing this because this scam sounded VERY real.
I received a call from someone claiming to be from RCBC, saying an RCBC representative would call me. A few hours later, another person called and told me I had ₱5,000 worth of "welcome points" and waived my Annual Fee. They explained it really well.
What made it convincing was that they already knew a lot of my information, including my full name, address, credit card details, and even the number of cards I have.
They instructed me to log in to my RCBC Pulz app, go to UnliPay, select Maya, and enter a "reference number" they provided, which was actually an account number.
They kept asking about enabling my biometrics, which makes it easier to make a transfer.
🚩 That's when I realised something was wrong.
It wasn't actually a points redemption. I was essentially being instructed to make a transfer to another account.
I immediately hung up and did not proceed. I also locked my card as a precaution.
Please be careful. Just because someone knows your personal and card information doesn't mean they're really from your bank.
Never give your OTP, PIN, CVV, or approve a transaction because someone called you.
If you're unsure, hang up and contact your bank directly using the official number.
Sharing this for awareness. Please share this with your family and friends. 🙏
#ScamAwareness #RCBC #Maya #OnlineScam #FraudAwareness

item.title:
Need mag-cash out ng GCash balance? You can now withdraw directly from participating RCBC ATMs using GCash QR! Here’s a quick guide on how to do it!
HOW TO WITHDRAW:
1️⃣ Open GCash → Others → Cash Out → RCBC Scan to Withdraw. Generate your QR code and enter your desired amount. 2️⃣ Visit a participating RCBC ATM, press ENTER, then select QR Cash Withdrawal. 3️⃣ Scan your QR code at the ATM, confirm the details, and collect your cash!
OTHER IMPORTANT THINGS TO KNOW:
• ₱18 fixed cash-out fee per transaction, regardless of the withdrawal amount. • Minimum withdrawal is ₱100, maximum is ₱5,000 per transaction. • Your QR code is valid for only 5 minutes, so generate it when you’re already at the ATM.
📌 Take note: This is a convenient alternative to cashing out through other outlets, especially when you need cash on hand. Check for participating RCBC ATMs near you before heading out!
Save this guide para ready ka next time na kailangan mong mag-withdraw ng GCash balance! 💙

item.title: ⚠️ WARNING: SHOCKINGLY LEGIT-SOUNDING RCBC CREDIT CARD SCAM ⚠️ ​May tumawag sa akin kanina na nagpapakilalang taga-RCBC. Sabi niya, may nag-attempt daw na mag-hack ng account ko. Sobrang convincing at tunog legit talaga—hindi mo iisiping scam! ​Sinakyan ko para malaman ko kung paano ang modus nila, pero nagulat ako kasi alam nila ang phone number, email, at pati bagong Hexa card ko! ​Nung naramdaman niyang nakuha na niya ang tiwala ko, sinabi niyang ibina-block daw nila ang hacker sa system at magpapadala sila ng IVR code. Dumating nga yung code! Yun pala, simultaneous call ang ginagawa nila: kausap nila ako habang tumatawag din sila sa hotline ng RCBC para mag-act as me! ​Sobrang kinabahan ako nung narealize kong konting-konti na lang at makukuha na nila ang full access sa account ko, kaya pinatay ko agad yung call. ​Guys, mag-iingat tayo lagi! Never share any OTP or IVR code kahit kanino. Stay vigilant! 🛡️💳

item.title:
RCBC credit card disputes can be ruthless.
I had a fraudulent transaction that I formally disputed for reversal. I submitted the required documents, within the prescribed timeframe, and based on the applicable Visa dispute rules.
Yet despite all that, they still refused to reverse the transaction.
Instead, they kept pushing me to pay for something I did not receive, did not use, and did not authorize.
And no, I WON’T.
For over a year now, I’ve been dealing with this case. There have been repeated demands for payment, different approaches that can make you feel pressured or scared, and then, at times, a denial of responsibility.
If you’re experiencing something similar with your bank or credit card provider, document everything. Keep your emails, dispute forms, supporting documents, dates, and reference numbers.
And if you believe your complaint is not being properly addressed, escalate it to BSP and keep following up.
Sa case ko, simple lang:
Hindi ko natanggap. Hindi ko ginastos. Hindi ko in-authorize. At kung kumpleto naman ang requirements ko at nasa tamang proseso ako, bakit ako ang pagbabayarin?
Over a year na.
And I’m still standing my ground.
Hindi ako magbabayad para sa transaction na hindi naman akin.
Pero yung mga kurap, Hindi naman nila ginaganito. Yung harapan na alam mo ninakawan ka, Hindi patas talaga. Napaka walang kwenta ng hustisya at securidad ng credit cards sa Pilipinas Hindi tulad sa ibang bansa na Basta tama Ang requirements, kumpleto at may mga ebidensya mabilis umaksyon.
Dito, pahirapan, garapal pa.

item.title: CREDIT TO CASH OFFER 1st CC ko sa RCBC is Flex Visa. Then nag open ako ng savings account and nag member ako sa Hexagon Club, and na-approve din ako sa CC Platinum Mastercard. Since no AF yung Hexagon Platinum MasterCard ko, pinaconsolidate ko na lang yung credit limit ko sa Flex Visa and Platinum Mastercard. Okay naman, na-approve naman so yung Platinum Mastercard na lang meron ako now. Pero nagtataka lang ako, since noon pa na may Flex Visa ako never ako na-offeran ng credit to cash ni RCBC. 😅 Kaya sa ibang bank tuloy ako nag aapply ng credit to cash which is mas mataas yung add on rate compared sa RCBC na nababasa ko around 0.39% to 0.42% yung offer sakanila. Paano kaya ma-offeran? Never naman ako nagka past due kay RCBC or sa any banks din na may CC ako. 😁 pwede ba yun i-request sa CS? Dedma kasi yung BM sa branch ng acct ko. 😅

item.title:
May tumawag sa akin na nagpakilalang taga-RCBC.
Sabi niya, tataasan daw ang credit limit ko at magiging **₱250,000** na. Sabi rin niya, papalitan daw ang payroll account ko into a **Savings Account**, at ipapadala raw sa address ko ang bagong account details kasama ang **check at passbook**.
Pagkatapos, pinapag-login niya ako sa **RCBC Pulz**. Pinapagawa niya sa akin na i-transfer daw ang available credit limit ko sa ibang account number, pero **pangalan ko rin ang nakalagay bilang account holder**.
Dahil medyo kahina-hinala na ang mga pinapagawa niya, **ini-end call ko na agad** at hindi ko itinuloy ang transfer.

item.title:
My Honest Experience with Atome.
I don’t usually post complaints online, but I feel I need to share this experience.
I fully paid my balance a long time ago. In fact, I followed the instructions given by one of your representatives and manually paid the remaining amount through DragonPay using the account details provided to me. I was even told that everything was settled and that I no longer needed to worry about it. Then suddenly, this September, I received an email saying that I still have an outstanding balance. When I checked the app, there it was.
My question is simple:
How can there be penalties and an outstanding balance when I already paid the amount in full and have proof of payment?
What makes the situation even more frustrating is the lack of customer support. I receive calls almost every minute, sometimes even during work hours and while resting. But when I answer, no one talks. I have already sent emails regarding this concern, yet I have not received a meaningful response. When I try to contact customer support, I am told that payment and transaction concerns are handled only through email. The problem is that my emails are not being properly addressed.
As a customer, I am willing to communicate and clarify the issue. I am not avoiding my responsibilities. I simply want a fair explanation and proper support. I also use other financial institutions such as UnionBank, RCBC, and BPI, and thankfully I have never experienced this kind of situation with them.
At this point, I do not intend to pay an amount that I genuinely believe has already been settled, especially when I have proof of payment.
I hope Atome can improve its customer service and provide customers with a direct and effective way to resolve payment concerns instead of relying solely on automated emails and repeated collection calls. Because of this experience, I have decided to stop using my Atome account despite having a high credit limit.
I am sharing this not to attack anyone, but to raise awareness and hopefully get the assistance that customers deserve.

item.title:
Hirap mong mahalin, RCBC. 😮‍💨
Not even an update. No follow-up email, ticket created, pero wala, useless yung 3-5 business dyas TAT. The branch people can’t even do anything about it because, as per them, their US Virtual Account has a separate department. So basically, you’re left waiting and chasing for answers yourself. For context, here’s the timeline: 📌 July 22 – Transaction was sent 📌 July 22 (same day) – Additional documents requested were uploaded 📌 July 24 – Visited the branch; they emailed their respective department regarding the transaction 📌 July 26 – Filed a formal complaint via email 📌 August 20 – Revisited the branch; a ticket was finally created. I was advised that the TAT was 3–5 business days 📌 As of today – NOTHING. No update, no resolution, no follow-up. And just to be clear, this issue has already been reported by the other party as well. It’s been weeks of following up, submitting documents, visiting the branch, and filing complaints and still, no clear answer or resolution. For a banking service that handles business transactions, this level of communication and follow-through is honestly disappointing. 😮‍💨
P.S. I completely understand that the transaction frequency and amount may trigger AMLA/compliance checks or internal thresholds. I respect that process pero TOTOO BA?!! WALA KAHIT ANO??
Anyone here na nka experience ng same issue??

item.title:
RCBC has waived transfer fees on its U.S. Virtual Account, a cross-border banking service under RCBC Pulz that lets Filipinos in the United States send money to the Philippines.
The waiver took effect on August 1, according to Executive Vice President and Chief Innovation and Inclusion Officer Lito Villanueva, who announced it during a keynote at the International Asian American Business Expo in Torrance, California, held August 7 to 8.
Villanueva positioned the fee waiver as part of RCBC’s broader push to serve the Filipino diaspora, alongside services such as the MySSS Card powered by RCBC DiskarTech.
An estimated 500,000 Filipinos live in the Los Angeles area, one of the largest Filipino communities in the United States.
He pointed to the scale of overseas Filipino remittances, which made up more than 7.3% of the Philippine economy in 2025, as reason for banks to keep improving cross-border services for Filipino families.

item.title:
Breaking free from financial struggle isn’t just about earning more; often, it’s about unlearning the cultural habits we inherited with good intentions, but heavy consequences.
If we want to build lasting peace of mind and generational wealth, here are 5 toxic money beliefs we need to gently leave behind:
1. "Ang anak ang retirement plan." Raising children is an act of unconditional love, not an investment strategy with an invoice attached. When we burden the next generation with our living and medical expenses, we trap them in survival mode. The greatest gift a parent can give their child is their own financial independence—so our kids can start their own families on solid ground, not from a deficit.
2. "Bahala na / Diyos na ang bahala." Faith is powerful, but using it as an excuse for lack of preparation isn't trust—it's neglect. God gives us the wisdom to budget, save, insure, and invest. Praying for abundance while refusing to build an emergency fund is like praying for rain without digging a well. Faith and financial discipline must go hand in hand.
3. "Deserve ko 'to" (Every single payday). Treating yourself is healthy, but using "self-care" to justify lifestyle inflation keeps us broke. When every bonus, overtime pay, or salary increase is immediately spent on instant gratification, we rob our future selves. You deserve peace of mind and debt-free sleep far more than another impulse checkout.
4. "Pakitang-tao" and the fear of saying "No." From extravagant fiestas and grand birthday blowouts to lending money we don't have just to save face, the fear of what relatives or neighbors will say drains our pockets. We often go into debt to impress people who aren't there when the bills arrive. Real wealth is quiet; genuine dignity doesn't need an audience.
5. Treating financial boundaries as "Kadamutan." In many families, the moment someone starts doing well, they are expected to solve everyone else's financial emergencies. Setting boundaries doesn't mean you're heartless; it means you understand that you cannot pour from an empty cup. Helping is noble, but subsidizing chronic poor choices only enables dependence.
Breaking these cycles isn’t about disrespecting our culture or being selfish. It’s about choosing to be the transition person in our family tree—the one who turns survival into security, and scarcity into a legacy.
Which of these mindsets felt the hardest to unlearn in your own journey?

item.title:
Hello po, I just want to ask something regarding RA 11055.
I've tried to previously use other banks for my SSS disbursement account but all ended in failure, so since I had to replace my lost UMID rin naman eh I decided to switch into the My.SSS ID ng Diskartech powered by RCBC. I need this loan pambili sana ng gamot ng papa ko, and since matured na rin naman yung contribution period ko. (Eligible na ako for 2-month loan)
First, when I tried to use my Digital copy of the National ID, their system was instead wanting me to take a screenshot of the actual National ID and when I tried to use the ePhilID, they kept refusing it.
I escalated it over BSP and then got a swift response only after the escalation to let me use my ePhilID instead. They took the data and are just needing my workplace information but they still kept rejecting it until my unverified Diskartech account was tagged as failed and was scheduled to be closed August 19, 2026. I waited patiently so I can restart the process kasi sabi ng agent nila, I can just re-submit documents sa mismong email after ma-close yung account.
The account was still not closed until now and keeps telling me about the failed verification. Worse, the next agent told me na hindi na pwedeng mag-reopen ng account sa kanila and I should just find an alternative bank.
This incident has been escalated over and over again with BSP and even PSA and I honestly don't know kung saan na lalapit. Patay na yung tatay ko for more than two months since the initial filing and gagamitin ko pa rin sana yung loan to shoulder yung expenses ng pagpapalibing pero wala pa rin akong nakukuha until now. I have been telling over and over that this is already causing me extreme mental distress to the point of self-harming and considering suicide, since kailangan ko po yung loan to start over due to switching workplaces na rin and hindi ko na rin gagamitin yung current payroll account ko with the bank.
Can anyone tell me any advice, please? Please don't tell me to get into another bank or use a deposit slip or any other thing na ginawa ko na but failed kasi putangina ng SSS website sa kaartehan, for the lack of a better word. I need help specifically regarding sa mismong issue na 'to.
Thanks po sa mga sasagot.

**Permission to post, Admin.**
Just sharing my experience with RCBC.
I opened my RCBC account online and started making transactions and putting money into my savings. After a year, I was able to reach ₱500,000 in savings.
I then went to the branch to get my debit card and asked if I qualified for RCBC Hexagon. I was able to get the **RCBC Hexagon Debit Card**.
On the same day I received my debit card, I also applied for a credit card through the branch. Fortunately, my application was approved, and I received the card within 10 days with a **₱500,000 credit limit**.
This is actually my **first credit card in my 34 years of existence**, so I’m really happy with the experience so far.
Just sharing in case this helps anyone who is considering opening an RCBC account or qualifying for Hexagon. 😊

item.title:
Got my SSS ATM Card.🧡
✨ Sharing is caring ..✨ NO PILA. NO HASSLE. , MAY SSS ID NA!💙
This serves as Official Gov't ID and also your disbursement account ATM in all your transactions in SSS like loans, pension etc.😊
​I finally got my MySSS CARD, and the best part? I didn’t have to wait in line at the SSS office at all! 🙌
📌 HOW TO APPLY SSS ID ONLINE (via Hello Money AUB.)
1️⃣. Pumunta sa SSS portal at piliin ang services then sa pinakababa just simply click the MySSS Card then fill up the needed requirements. Meron dalawang preferred bank disbursement account the Diskartech via RCBC and Hello Money via AUB, its up to you kung anong pipiliin mo but for me ang pinili kong disbursement account ay via AUB. Pag natapos mo na mag fill up bibigyan ka agad ng transaction number.
2️⃣. Go to your play store app then download the Hello Money by AUB app, gumawa ng Account sa AUB, after mo mag pagregister it will take 24 hours lang para ma-approve ang account mo.
3️⃣. After mo aapprove ng account mo, mag sign in ka lang sa Hello Money Aub app at pwede kana kumuha ng MySSS ID card, using the transaction code.
4️⃣ Tap up your Hello Money Account for only 250 pesos to pay your MySSS Card Id. (Dapat may laman na 250 ang Hello Money App mo need mo mag cash in) After nun lalabas ang QR Code, at iyon lang ang ipapakita mo sa mga piling branch ng AUB.
Since taga Quezon City ako nag search ako kung saan pwede mag claim (hindi lahat ng branch ay pwede ka mag claim, pili lang po ang branch na my sss atm card) napili ko pong branch ay sa AUB Visayas Avenue. Napakadali lang ng process, at di ako inabot ng 30 minutes basta di lang magloko yong internet connection nila!😊
Kung sakali na kayo ay mag-aapply ng pension claim or maternity benefit, dito na agad papasok ang inyong pera. Hindi na din kailangan magpicture dahil kung naka register na kayo sa National ID nyo ay dun na kukunin ang picture.📸 Online lang ang process at pipick upin nalang, di na kailangan pumunta or pumila ng SSS Branch.
Remember wag po kayong basta-basta pupunta ng AUB na wala pang QR code, kasi yon po ang ipapakita ninyo pag pumunta na kayo sa AUB to claim your MYSSS Card ID.💙 #CttoRepost

item.title:
‼️I think scammers called me‼️
Una may tumawag from RCBC credit daw, and ipapadala na daw nila yung Hexagon Platinum CC ko. Kako nareceive ko na 3 weeks ago. Sabi nya World mastercard nalang daw ipapadala nila. Mali address na binigay nya, so nag offer sya na branch pick up nalang daw. And tatawag daw manager after ng call na yun.
2nd caller, manager daw, ako pinapa decide kung magkanong credit limit gusto ko. Need daw updated Pulz app ko para makita ko na don yung CC ko and credit limit ko. Kako updated naman. Pero may isesend daw sila sa email ko na need kong gamitin pang update ng app. Nung na feel ko na na baka scam, kako kung approved man ako sa kahit anong card, padala nalang nila sa branch ko. Kako sa google play lang ako mag uupdate. Ni end nya yung call and wala rin akong email na nareceive.
Nakakatakot na marami silang details na alam. And kung legit man sila, may chance po ba na ikaw mag dedecide kung magkano credit limit na gusto mo?

at first di ako sumagot. then nag offer ulit na pwede ma amend pa yung principal amount na pwede i installment(₱300k daw ang i installment plus interest, ₱84k straight charge)
so may dilemma is should i agree dito or ipilit ko na imeet nila yung initial applied amount ko na ₱32k ish??
🥹

item.title:
What are your thoughts on RCBC’s latest fee updates effective October 30, 2026? Personally, I think the 1% Foreign Transaction Service Fee isn’t too surprising since several banks have already implemented similar charges for transactions with foreign merchants, even if they’re billed in PHP.
However, the Unli Installment processing fee is the bigger disappointment. One of RCBC’s biggest advantages was the flat ₱200 processing fee for large conversions. With the new 1% processing fee on transactions of ₱20,000 and above, converting high-value purchases will now cost significantly more.
RCBC Fee Changes
1. Foreign Transaction Service Fee (NEW)
* Before: ₱0 additional fee for many PHP transactions from foreign merchants.
* Now: 1% fee even if you’re billed in PHP, as long as the merchant or payment processor is located outside the Philippines.
2. Unli Installment Processing Fee
Transaction Before Now
₱20,000 ₱200 ₱200
₱50,000 ₱200 ₱500
₱100,000 ₱200 ₱1,000
₱300,000 ₱200 ₱3,000
What do you think? Are these changes reasonable, or do you think they make RCBC less competitive compared to other banks?

item.title:
Sa mga wala pay SSS Card dira, chance na ninyo ni and dali lang kayo ang process.
Requirements: ​You must have an SSS online account (My.SSS). ​You must have a National ID (PhilSys) or valid ID. ​You need ₱200 in your DiskarTech account to pay for the physical card.
How to apply online ​Step 1: Request on the SSS Portal ​Go to member.sss.gov.ph and log in. ​Click Services > MySSS Card. ​Choose RCBC DiskarTech as your bank. ​Agree to the terms and click Submit. ​Copy the Transaction Number shown on the screen (you will also get an email with it). ​Step 2: Set up the RCBC DiskarTech App ​Download the RCBC DiskarTech app on your phone. ​Tap Register and select "SSS Member". ​Enter your Transaction Number from Step 1 along with your SSS number. ​Take a photo of your ID and a selfie to verify your identity. ​Wait 24–48 hours for your account to be approved. ​Step 3: Order Your Physical Card ​Open the DiskarTech app and go to Cards. ​Tap Request Physical MySSS Card. ​Deposit at least ₱200 into your DiskarTech account to pay the card fee. ​Confirm your delivery address. ​Your card will arrive in about 15–20 working days.
Note: You have option to pick up in your nearest Bank. 10 days lang akoa nakuha na dayon naku..

item.title:
𝐏𝐈𝐒𝐎 𝐅𝐀𝐑𝐄 𝐂𝐀𝐒𝐇𝐁𝐀𝐂𝐊 𝐏𝐑𝐎𝐌𝐎 𝐍𝐆 𝐑𝐂𝐁𝐂 𝐒𝐀 𝐋𝐑𝐓-𝟐, 𝐄𝐗𝐓𝐄𝐍𝐃𝐄𝐃 𝐇𝐀𝐍𝐆𝐆𝐀𝐍𝐆 𝐀𝐔𝐆𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝟑𝟏
Nakipagtulungan ang Department of Transportation (DOTr) sa Rizal Commercial Banking Corporation (RCBC) at Philippine Social Security System (SSS) upang palawigin pa hanggang August 31 ang Piso Fare Cashback Promo para sa mga gumagamit ng cashless payments sa LRT-2.
Ito’y kasunod ng utos ng Pangulo na gawing mas abot-kaya ang pamasahe sa tren, kasabay ng pagsusulong ng digitalization para sa mas mabilis at mas komportableng biyahe ng mga pasahero.
“Nagpapasalamat tayo sa RCBC at SSS, pati na kay Finance Secretary Frederick Go, dahil na-extend itong piso fare cashback promo para sa mga pasahero ng LRT-2. Dapat hanggang July 31 lang ito, pero na-extend natin hanggang August 31. Malaking tulong ito sa mga komyuter dahil ‘yung matitipid nilang pamasahe, pwede pa nilang magamit ngayon sa ibang bagay tulad ng pambaon sa eskwela at pambili ng pagkain o gamot,” ayon kay Transportation Secretary Banoy Lopez.
Kasama sa mga pwedeng mag-avail ng Piso Fare Cashback Promo sa LRT-2 ang mga pasaherong gagamit ng MySSS Card at RCBC debit at credit cards sa cashless fare gates ng tren.
Dahil sa promo, piso na lang ang magiging pamasahe pagsakay ng tren, kaya makakatipid ng hanggang Php17 kada biyahe ang mga pasahero depende sa kanilang destinasyon. Pwedeng mag-avail ng promo ng hanggang walong beses sa isang araw.
#DOTrPH🇵🇭 #BagongPilipinas

Hingi lang advice , Meron akong Rcbc Salary Loan at Updated ako sa payment .. nagkaroon ako ng pagkakataon na i full payment ang balance ko kaya nag request ako ng for termination .. hindi ako naka recieve ng email galing rcbc kaya naisip ko baka hnd na approve nag decide ako na wag nalang i full payment dahil may pinag gamitan din ako ng pera , nag patuloy nalang ako sa salary deduct kada payroll . June 1st week naka tanggap ako ng Letter Galing sa RGS Recovery Management and Collections ang laman ng sulat kailangan ko raw bayaran ng full payment yung balance ko sa rcbc dahil na approve daw yung ni request kong termination ,
Wala akong cash na hawak ngaun para bayaran ng full yung balance ko .. pinipilit nila ako na bayaran ko na daw para hindi na daw mag ka problema .. Sinabi ko na baka pwede sa ituloy nalang yung salary deduction kada payroll ayaw nilang pumayag. ..

item.title:
TRANSFER FEES ADJUSTMENT
Nagsimula nang magkaroon ng adjustment sa transfer fees sa ilang banko sa bansa.
Nanguna rito ang Bank of the Philippines Islands, kung saan libre na ang transfer fees.
Sumunod ang Rizal Commercial Banking Corporation (RCBC) sa pamamagitan ng RCBC Pulz at DiskarTech app na may 30 free InstaPay transfers kada buwan.
Habang ang banking app din na Maya ay binabaan na sa P10 ang transfer fee sa mga lokal na banko at e-wallet applications na magsisimula sa July 6.
Kasunod ito ng Circular No. 1238 ng Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas na nagtatakdang ibaba o gawing ‘reasonable’ ang fund transfer fees ng mga banko at iba pang financial institutions.
#RMNnews #TatakRMN

Lauman nga madamo pa nga mga bangko ang magapatuman sang zero transfer fee.

item.title:
𝐆𝐎𝐎𝐃 𝐍𝐄𝐖𝐒: RCBC, ZERO-FEE TRANSFERS NA RIN SIMULA BUKAS! MAS DUMADAMI ANG LIBRENG DIGITAL TRANSACTIONS.
Simula bukas, July 4, 2026, ipatutupad na ng RCBC ang zero-fee InstaPay transfers. Ito ay kasunod ng pagpapatupad ng LandBank at BPI ng kaparehong inisyatiba para sa mas abot-kayang digital payments.
Sa pagdami ng mga bangkong nag-aalok ng libreng InstaPay transfers, mas maraming Pilipino ang nakakapagpadala ng pera nang walang dagdag na bayarin—kaya mas buo at mas napapakinabangan ang kanilang pinaghirapang kita.
Bilang pangunahing tagapagtaguyod ng digital transformation, patuloy na sinusuportahan ng DICT ang mga inisyatibang tulad nito na nagpapalawak ng access sa digital financial services at nagpapababa ng gastos sa digital transactions, tungo sa mas inclusive na digital economy.
Ngayon, hindi lang mas konektado ang mga Pilipino, mas magaan na rin sa bulsa ang bawat digital transaction. At sa bawat bayaring natitipid, mas lumalapit tayo sa isang mas inklusibo at mas makabagong digital economy.
#DICT #RCBC #DigitalTransaction #DigitalBayanihan

item.title:
RCBC DiskarTech Introduces Unlimited Free InstaPay Transfers
Starting July 4, 2026, RCBC DiskarTech customers can enjoy unlimited free InstaPay transfers when sending money to other local banks, subject to the app’s daily transaction limit of ₱499,999.99.
In a separate update, RCBC Pulz also began offering 30 free InstaPay transfers per month with a minimum transfer amount of ₱100, giving RCBC customers more ways to enjoy free bank transfers.

item.title:
BREAKING: RCBC joins BPI in cutting InstaPay fees
The Yuchengco family-led Rizal Commercial Banking Corp. is making eligible InstaPay transfers free starting July 4, offering up to 30 fee-free person-to-person transfers each month through its main banking app.
Its financial inclusion app, DiskarTech, will continue providing unlimited free InstaPay transfers.
The move follows Bank of the Philippine Islands' boarder move to permanently remove InstaPay and PESONet fees, adding momentum to the shift toward lower-cost digital banking.
Story link in the comments.

item.title:
MAY ILANG POSSIBLE NA DAHILAN KUNG BAKIT NAWALA ANG OFFER MO:
✅Nagkaroon ng regular na re-evaluation ang RCBC sa account mo. ✅Nagbago ang internal lending criteria o limit allocation nila. ✅Pansamantalang inalis ang eligibility mo kahit maganda ang repayment history.
May posibilidad pa rin na bumalik ang offer sa susunod na evaluation cycle. Maraming users ang nakakaranas na nawawala ang Payday NOW at bumabalik pagkalipas ng ilang linggo o 1–3 buwan.
Habang naghihintay: ✅Patuloy na panatilihing active ang RCBC account mo. ✅Siguraduhing may regular na pumapasok na payroll o funds kung applicable. ✅I-check ang RCBC app paminsan-minsan, lalo na pagkatapos ng payday, dahil madalas doon nag-a-update ang mga loan offers.

item.title:
FOR AWARENESS‼️‼️‼️ GCASH IS NO LONGER SAFE FOR ME‼️
I never thought na ma-eexperience ko ito with GCash. This is very alarming and raises serious concerns about account security.
Last Saturday morning, pag gising ko at pag-check ko ng GCash account ko, sobrang gulat ko dahil ₱45 na lang ang natira sa balance ko. When I checked my transaction history, I discovered an unauthorized transfer sent to an RCBC/DiskarTech account ending in 4383 nangyari ang transaction is around 8:00am at tulog pa ako nyan😭
Mas nakakaalarma pa dahil the transaction was processed as a regular GCash-to-bank transfer. As you can see, hindi ito dumaan sa alinman sa mga naka-link na account ko sa GCash. May kasama pa itong usual Instapay fee, which indicates that it went through the standard bank transfer process.
I immediately contacted GCash regarding this matter, and they informed me that the case is still under investigation. However, hindi nila masagot kung bakit itong particular GCash-to-RCBC transfer lang ang transaction na wala akong natanggap na kahit anong notification, email, SMS, o OTP.
Normally, an OTP is required before a bank transfer can be completed, and may marereceive ka ring confirmation via email or SMS once successful ang transaction. But in this case, I received absolutely nothing.
I am sharing this experience to raise awareness and remind everyone to regularly monitor their accounts and transaction history. Nakakadismaya at nakakaalarma na may ganitong klaseng transaction na maaaring mangyari nang walang anumang alert na natatanggap ang account owner.
Hopefully, this issue will be resolved soon, and GCash will provide a clear explanation of what really happened. For now, please stay vigilant and double-check your accounts regularly.
GCash We Are GCash
#FraudPrevention #FraudAwareness #FraudAlert #GCASH #GCASHUNSAFE

item.title:
RCBC Credit card scam I received a phone call from someone claiming to be from RCBC. He sounded very professional at first, but there were early red flags. He offered me a credit card from RCBC that would supposedly be sent directly to my address.
The scary part? He already knew all of my personal details.
Here were the red flags:
1. He said RCBC initiated the credit card
I’ve never heard of banks sending out credit cards without the customer applying or giving approval first.
2. He mentioned an “RCBC Pulz App 2.0”
There’s no such thing as RCBC Pulz App 2.0. The current RCBC Pulz app already has an option to add your credit card if you have one.
I decided to play along, and he transferred me to his “supervisor,” who sounded less professional and much more pushy. He asked what I planned to use the credit card for and even suggested I say it was for business so they could approve a ₱500,000 credit limit.
Later, he said he would send me an email with a link to download the “new RCBC Pulz 2.0” and that I would receive a verification code.
A few moments later, I received an actual text message from RCBC for a password reset.
That’s when I immediately ended the call and contacted RCBC to secure and change my account details.
Please stay vigilant. Never share OTPs, verification codes, or click suspicious links—even if the caller sounds legitimate.

item.title:
Oh God, this just happened to me now. May tumawag sakin na number lang from RCBC daw.
Good thing that I never link my cc sa RCBC Pulz app. I just registered it while I was on the call then when the representative kuno said to click on the unlipay button may 24hrs pa na need for me to use it. So hindi natuloy.
I was not aware of the unlipay thing buti na lang I was with my partner nung sinagot ko tawag.
Bungad nila sakin iggrant daw ako ng new CC with 495k limit then as a welcoming gift, may 5k daw ako marereceive either via deposit or can be used as payment ng outstanding balance. I went for the outstanding payment kasi di affiliated daw ni rcbc yung bank ko. So since di pa maaccess unlipay tatawag daw sakin sa Lunes. Pagkababa ng call sabi ng partner ko scam daw yun kasi bakit unlipay.
Kaya pala last Tuesday may nareceive ako na nagapply daw ako cc sa rcbc which I did not kaya after ng call, I checked the message again and ayun same day pala may nagmessage na di daw approve and both is from RCBC registered number. Kaya mas lalo ako sure na scammer tumawag sakin.
Ang galing eh parang pro and taga bank talaga sila. Nagsabi pa na wag daw magbibigay ng cc details, otp or any number. Pero may binigay sila na cash back rebate account number para raw sa 5k.
Nakakaloka parang naka double pay din ata today ang scammer. Happy Independence day Lol

item.title: Meron ba dito naka experience na nagbigay ng false information ang customer service ng bank for CC? Na approved ako sa RCBC and prior activation I called RCBC first to ask if I am qualified for a NAFFL. Nag YES si officer and explained that I need to spend first accumulated 60k within 60 days. So since may confirmation si bank, inactivate ko ang card then spent 60k which is pasok sa conditions na binigay (Note: hindi ko talaga i-activate ang card if walang NAFFL na offer kaya tinawag ko muna). Now, after ko makapag spent ng 60k tumawag ulit ako to confirm if NAFFL na yung card and again the officer confirmed na NAFFL na nga. Bali dalawang officer yung nakausap ko wayback, confirming nga na NAFFL yung card ko. Then sadly, this year bigla ako nacharge ng annual fee kaya tumawag ako agad sa customer service and this time hindi nga daw ako qualified for NAFFL wayback. Yung nakausap kong officer recently confirmed to me as well na nag bigay nga ng false information yung dalawang naunang officer. May question is if may chance ba na i-waived nila yung Annual fee charge this year since may lapses din sa part nila? Pina pullout ko rin kasi yung recorded call before so I can use it on filing complaint kay BSP incase na hindi nila pag bigyan request ko to waived my cc AFFL.

item.title:
📌Finally‼️🩷
I GOT MY SSS ID 🥰🙏
Wanna know how to get an SSS card powered by RCBC Diskartech?
Here are the Requirements and Step:
Note: Kailangan ay member ng SSS at may Philsys Number or National ID or any Valid IDs
Step 1: Go to SSS Portal - Log in to your Account - Go to Member info/Services then select "Apply for my SSS Card" - Select RCBC DiskarTech - Agree with data sharing and save the Transaction Number. (Copy/Paste the transaction Number)
Step 2: Download DiskarTech App - Register and choose SSS Member during sign up - Enter the transaction number, phone number and OTP - Complete the process (Selfie and any government Valid ID) -If gusto mo ng Physical ID, you must load your wallet P200 then avail the card.
Step 3: Wait for the Delivery or You can get the card on your chosen RCBC branch near you.
#SSSmembers #UMIDnoMore #RCBCdiskarTech #everyone #fypシ゚ @highlight

item.title:
Can’t log in to RCBC Pulz? Here’s how to get back in.
Step 1: Start your password reset Tap “Forgot User ID or Password” on the login screen. Select “I forgot my Password,” then enter your User ID or registered email and account number.
Step 2: Verify your request Enter the OTP sent to your registered mobile number. Check your SMS for your temporary password and use this to log in.
Step 3: Create your new password Re-enter the temporary password to confirm your identity, then set your new password based on the required format.
Step 4: Confirm and access your account Enter the final OTP to complete your reset. You can now log in using your new password.
You’re all set. Log in and keep your finances moving with RCBC Pulz.

item.title:
Btw guys, nabuksan ko na yung rcbc pulz app ko grabeng troubleshoot ginawa ko at ayon gumana na sya.
Sa mga hindi pa mabuksan ito yung steps:
Step 1: forgot user and pass Step 2: wait nyo lang mag send ng temporary password Step 3: Go to Chrome or Google and Search "Rcbc Online" Step 4: Log in ur User ID and Password "yung password nyo is yun yung ilalagay nyo na temporary pass" Step 5: Pag lumabas na yung "Change Password" and may nakita kayong Current Password yun parin ilagay nyo don sa temporary password Step 6: After ng step 5 pag na change password nyo na, punta naman kayo sa rcbc pulz app Step 7: Log in nyo User ID and yung bago nyong password Step 8: after ma-login may makikita kayo device na phone i-remove nyo lang yon Step 9: After remove, access nyo na ulit yung device nyo and basic nalang yung susunod na step. Step 10: Lagyan nyo ng Biometric (Fingerprint) yung pass para madali nalang mag access.
So yun lang, sana makatulong 🙏🏼

item.title:
May mas makatarungan na paraan!
Today’s signing ceremony between SSS and RCBC marks the launch of SSS Loan Lite, offering eligible members up to ₱20,000 in loans payable within 12 months at 8% p.a interest. With RCBC DiskarTech as the first of five partner banks, applications, disbursement, and repayments can now be done digitally, giving Filipinos a safer and more affordable alternative to high-interest informal lending.
This partnership also expands access to essential financial services. Members can manage their MySSS accounts, use DiskarTech for everyday banking, and get a MySSS debit card for cashless transactions.
Supported by both digital tools and on-ground assistance in RCBC and SSS branches, the initiative aims to make financial services more accessible, practical, and inclusive for more Filipinos.

item.title:
Dear Valued ATM Go Merchant, Magandang araw!
We would like to inform you of a current transaction behavior that may affect some ATM Go withdrawals.
Sa ilang pagkakataon, may transactions na hindi fully successful kahit mukhang nag-proceed. Dahil dito, automatic na nababalik ang amount sa customer, kahit na naibigay na ng merchant ang cash.
Upang maiwasan ang ganitong pangyayari, please follow the guidelines below:
Kapag WALANG na print na receipt, DO NOT DISBURSE cash to the customer.
I-advise ang customer na maghintay ng 5 minutes para bumalik ang amount sa kanilang account.
Mag-release lamang ng cash kapag may successful transaction receipt.
This is to ensure na parehong protected ang merchant at customer from any discrepancies.
If you have questions or concerns, you may contact us at atmgohelpdesk@rcbc.com.
Maraming salamat sa inyong cooperation.
Sincerely,
ATM Go Team

item.title: RCBC Pulz is not secure; it appears there may be an internal security breach. I recently had 107,000 PHP stolen from my account and transferred to several third-party accounts. The app's lack of security makes it far too easy to manipulate. ​The bank's investigation process has been poor and unhelpful. Despite being a loyal user, I no longer trust their online banking system. Even though I reported the incident to a physical branch immediately, they offered no real assistance in recovering my funds. ​I have now waited 65 days for a resolution. Had the bank taken immediate action when I first reported the theft, they could have frozen the recipient accounts and potentially recovered my money. When I visited the RCBC branch on November 26 to confirm the unauthorized transfers, the staff refused to take direct action. Instead of freezing the suspicious accounts immediately, they simply told me to call customer service to open a ticket. Their lack of urgency is unacceptable."

item.title:
long context short:
Jhay Buisa gumanap as a midman sa transaction namin ng buyer ko ng look (koreano buyer) nung July 24, 2025 pa.
Initially, sesend sana sakin ng koreano ung remaining balance via Paypal to paypal transaction pero Jhay told us na isesend nalang ung bayad sa bank niya since cheaper daw ung service fee. We checked and yeah its cheaper compared to sending the money to my Paypal account kaya we agreed to Jhay's advice. The money was transferred and i shipped the look 564 frameset to korea a few weeks later. The amount of the transfer was 2,405,930 korean won, or 97,779 pesos.
The problem here is "wala" pa daw ung pera na sinend ng koreano by bank to bank transfer. Its been 7 months and di inaasikaso ni Jhay ung transfer ng koreano worth 98k pesos. All he does is ignore and matagal na yan di nagrereply. Ive been asking him to inquire sa bank niya about the transfer kung san napunta pero nag iignore lang naman. The only time he inquired sa customer service/bank was during the 1st week of the transfer which is still under the usual turn around time of an international bank transfer. Di na niya finollow up the following months kasi nga nagiignore na. Matagal ko na kinailangan ung pera ko na yan lmao. Ilang buwan na lumipas to the point na it seemed suspicious if totoo ba talaga na hindi pa daw niya narereceive ung transfer ng koreano
So, what i did was email RCBC bank to check on the issue. I was advised rin na ireport ko nalang din to sa PNP cybercrime for thorough investigation if nareceive na ba tlga ung pera or nagsisinungaling lang si Jhay. Could be possible that the transfer was held and Jhay didnt know, but thats why I was telling him in the first place to check with rcbc about it lmao. Orrr, he could be lying na hindi pa niya daw narereceive ung transfer ng Koreano. The only way to find out the truth is to file a complaint kay RCBC kasi he is just ignoring me about it. Na para bang binabalewala niya lang 98k ko 🤷🤷

item.title:
New RCBC Scam – PLEASE READ
Sharing this because it almost got me, and I don’t want anyone else falling for it.
I received an SMS that appeared to come from RCBC / RCBC Credit, saying I was eligible for ₱6,516 cashback from credit card points. The message looked legit, the amount was very specific, and the link led to a very professional-looking RCBC page.
⚠️ Here’s the catch: The site asked for card number, expiry date, and CVV to “verify” the redemption.
That’s when I stopped.
👉 Banks will NEVER ask for your CVV. Ever. 👉 The link was NOT an official RCBC domain (rcbc-gifts.com). 👉 Even if the SMS looks like it came from a registered RCBC sender or an existing message thread, it can still be spoofed.
This is a new, very convincing phishing scam. If you enter your details, your card can be used immediately for fraudulent transactions.
Please remember:
❌ No bank will ask for your CVV ❌ Don’t click redemption links from SMS ✅ Redeem points only via official apps or by typing the bank’s website yourself ✅ When in doubt, call the number at the back of your card
Posting this so no one learns the hard way. Stay alert and protect your cards. 🙏 RCBC

item.title:
FORMAL COMPLAINT / FINAL DEMAND TO SKYCABLE
Subject: Formal Complaint – No Service Despite Active Billing (Violation of RA 7394)
To: SkyCable Customer Service / Billing Department
Good day,
I am formally lodging a complaint regarding my SkyCable subscription under Account No. *685376539*
Despite my account being active and fully paid, I have experienced no cable / intermittent service from *December 29, 2025* up to present. I continue to be billed even though the service is not being delivered.
Since my billing is auto debit with my RCBC credit card, i checked with RCBC and found out that last payment to Skycable was last Dec 20 with appoval code no 284871. So I can not understand why Sky Kyla kept on informing that I have an overdue amount of Php4,260.
I have repeatedly attempted to seek assistance; however, responses are limited to an AI system (Kyla of Sky) and no effective human support or resolution has been provided.
Please be informed that:
•Charging for a service that is not delivered constitutes a violation of the Consumer Act of the Philippines (RA 7394), particularly Articles 50, 52, and 53.
•Consumers have the right to service delivery, billing adjustment, refund, and proper redress.
I am formally demanding:
1. Immediate restoration of service, OR
2. Full billing adjustment/refund for the entire period with no service, AND
3. A clear explanation and timeline for resolution.
If this matter is not resolved within 5 working days, I will be constrained to escalate this complaint to the DTI and the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC), including submission of billing records and proof of AI-only responses.
I trust this can be resolved promptly.
Subscriber
JOSEPH JAMES MENDOZA

item.title: Hello po, Good Afternoon. Ask ko lang po. Nag payday loan kasi ako sa RCBC tapos last due ko na, may tumawag sakin last oct 30 na overdue ko nadaw sa payday ko (4payroll to pay) so nag assume ako 2mos to pay, tapos sabi nung agent from bank daw sya is ovwrdue nadaw ako need na pabayaran ang balance, so oct 31 nag pay ako Rcbc Pulz - Billspayment > RCBC Credit (Bankard) tapos input account number sa payday loan ko. Pagka pay ko nagtext ang RCBC na receieve na nila ang payment pero until now di padin nag rereflect ang payment ko sa Payday loan. Sana po matulongan huhu.

item.title:
Hassle ng customer service ng RCBC Credit RCBC ever since I got their card way back years ago.
🚨 WARNING to RCBC Credit Card Users 🚨
On July 10, 2025, I requested RCBC to: ✅ Terminate my credit card ✅ Use my rewards points for my final bill ✅ Reverse my annual membership fee (since I’m terminating the card)
Instead of resolving my simple request, RCBC: ❌ Delayed for over a month ❌ Gave vague & unrelated answers ❌ Charged me late payment & interest (caused by THEIR delay) ❌ Suspended my account without fixing the issue
This is unacceptable and unfair to customers. I have filed a complaint with the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and will not stop until this is resolved.
📌 To my fellow cardholders: be careful. 📌 To RCBC: stop punishing customers for YOUR delays.
#RCBC #CreditCard #ConsumerRights #BSP #BadCustomerService

Use your RCBC Credit Card to pay tuition and fees and convert your straight payments for up to 36 months Unli Installment! 🏛️

item.title:
I just want to rant and tell everyone how poor RCBC customer service is.
I have already emailed RCBC Bankard about this matter but their customer service was really disappointing eventhough I looped BSP on my complaint. No sense of urgency, I kept getting same responses na parang robot ang kausap ko. I have a Hexagon Savings account and 2 credit cards (Visa Platinum and Hexagon Platinum).
I made a reward conversion request on my Visa Platinum and called the hotline on 04/12/2025 around 11:00 am and I was advised that it was on processed.
At 4:00 pm that day, I received a call from the same agent who processed my request and told me that it could not be processed as the rewards can only be converted into miles. I was just wondering why didn't she mention it when I initially made the request. I should be informed outright that it cannot be done.
Also, this card was upgraded from Gold Visa 1-2 years ago. When I requested for an upgrade, I asked the agent multiple times if the rewards/miles can also be converted into cash as I always do that since 2018. The agent confirmed.
Clearly, I was misinformed twice by your agents. I emailed RCBC for reconsideration to use my reward points to something else instead of miles, I understand if hindi talaga allowed but the way they handle my frustration and concern was really upsetting. No courtesy for all the inconveniences this has brought me. They sent same templated emails over and over again. Ganun ba talaga RCBC? I decided to just cancel my cards and pull out my savings account. Everytime I call your hotline, your CS sucks.

item.title:
‼️AWARENESS FOR RCBC CREDIT CARD HOLDER‼️
—This is my saddest experience yesterday I want to share this story basin maka encounter pud mo . So gahapon 3pm natulog ko nakamata rako kay naay cgeg tawag sa akoa and akoa ge answer na alimongawan ko then I heard sa background kay kanang usually nga naa ta sulod sa Banko nga mga kasikas ang naa sa line niana “Mabuhay this Den from Rcbc Credit Card “ I believe this Marlah chuchu . Then ana sya ma’am Congratulations your Pre-Qualified to RCBC SALARY LOAN and pag ingon nya ana nakadawat dayun kog txt message makita man ara ang txt message so padayon mis conversation until sya ang niingon sa akoa nga maam imong user id sa online bank is(blah-blah) and yes correct iya ge provide so ako padayon kay nganu aware man sya sa credentials nku even name sa akoa parent he mentioned too and lasting he knows my birthday too after that conversation I received message regarding my OTP and ako nga na alimongawan pa og gadinanghag I give it to him and after that boom I receive a following message that my CREDIT CARD HAS BEEN USE FOR UNLIPAY amounting 220,000k while my credit card limit is only 150k and it’s already been use so my big question is nganon naka widraw mag ingon ana kadako nga dman ingon ana kadako ako card limit and when I ask Rcbc Credit Card Customer Service they just simply say nga yes maam pwd na sya maam kay Auto increase daw (ambot wala ko na satisfied sa tubag like nganu naay card limit kung pwd man d ay mulapas?) so human atu pagkamalas kay hasta akoa Funds nga almost 21k nag bababye pud kay lagi ga dinanghag ko nakahatg kos OTP so lesson learned nalang ni naku and unta dna ni cla kabiltima og lain pa 🤦‍♀️ and I already raised this issue to RCBC and I need to wait 40-90days para ani kay need pa nila e investigate. They also advised me if mubayad og card or credit card dapat tan awon jud daw kay karun some of scammers kay front and back rajud ila need maka access na sila ana samot nag sa mga public place ta mag kuan2 sa atung card Kay mga maau na kaau ni sila . Mao ning Marcos administration samot kadaghan ang adik mang scam nalang para maka sustento sa bisyo paita but anyway Lesson Learned Na Lang ni nku bisan pag kinsa ng mutawag ninyu nga bisag kaila pa sya tibuok pamilya maypa pagngon nalang ditso.
Maka depress samot na ang 21k funds naku wanay pag-asa bcn mas need to nya . Eampo nalang ni nku og maninda nalang kog taman ani laban nalang kay unsaon man 😭 Basta naay mawala naa may mabalik nga bigger blessing so think positive lng ghapon ta kay that’s life man so uban diha mag mindful ta pamaayo extra careful jud ta maypa enegosyo ang kwarta kay mudaghan pa .
Ang important 220,000k sa ako credit card is ma dispute pa bahalag kani nalang kay na mabuang kog binayad ani 🤦‍♀️

item.title:
Nakakapagod at ang sakit sa ulo kakaisip but will try my part para magawan ng action.
I already called the RCBC Hotline including Credit Card (8888-1888) since yesterday at nagawan nman na daw ng investigation report at my nabigay na Reference No. Till today nagffollow-up ko thru Telephone No. at 5 teller/agent na rin nakakausap ko para magawan agad ng response. Its just 45-90 banking days daw magaantay ng email/ response from the investigation report kasi nasa processing department na daw. Once meron na they will inform me on the findings kung valid or invalid.
Kaninang umaga pumunta na rin ako sa PNP-ACG to file a complaint for Fraud Incident. I explained what happened and presented the files/proof kung paano yung naging transactions. Hindi daw nman ito bago and madami na rin ganitong modus. Yun lang para daw magawan ng report kailangan makita kung ano, saan at kanino naitransact yung mga lumabas sa messages at SOA ko.
Namanipulate lang ako nung nagpanggap na taga RCBC with my post last April 15, 2024 na nahack daw account which yun na pala hacker. Napaisip lang ako nun taga RCBC siya at alam nung tumawag ang credit card no.ko. The way siya magsalita at pano yung process is ganun din aa mga regular teller hanggang sa sinabi na gagawan ng report yung Fraud Incident at para maiproceed daw yung report my code daw na ibbigay sila which is the OTP pala na after the call I made yesterday sa mismong hotline wala daw report or any fraud incident na record sa kanila including yung reference no.at name nung tumawag na Charles Uy daw (Kingina 😖)
During the call with the teller nun kinabahan at nanghihina after realizing na yung tumawag nung April 15, 2024 ai hacker/ scammer. Dito ko lang narealize na gawa2 lang pala time na yun kwento at naitransact mismo yung amount = P274,580.00 na puro “37 Unlipay” ginawang transactions. Inaalala ko din araw na yun at my ginawa ako sa office habang kausap yun and ginawa niya na pala pagsscam without knowing na modus pala.
Ang bigat sa loob na diko agad nalaman kung hindi ako tumawag kasi magddue date na rin at naging kampante ako na akala ko nagawan ng report yun pala victim na ako. Mahirap sabihan na bakit ganun nangyari, kahit ako diko mawari na naging tanga ako sa ganung tawag. Im just hoping to have proper and urgent action.
Salamat sa mga nagaalala at nagbbigay advice diko po maisa kaya ginawa ko ito to update na rin. Also to inform awareness sa lahat.

item.title:
A businesswoman filed a complaint before the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) after she lost P1 million in her bank account.
Flordelina Chan ignored numerous messages on one-time passwords on October 26 and October 27 because she didn’t use online banking for her transactions, GMA News reported.
She said she called the bank after she received a message which warned her about a suspicious transaction and that a report would be made on her inquiry.
Chan said she found out that she lost more than P1 million after she personally went to the bank.
Chan immediately sought the help of the NBI Cybercrime Division following the incident.
The Rizal Commercial Banking Corporation (RCBC) D. Tuazon Branch has written Chan a letter, saying it could not return the money lost due to the OTP and the lack of a breach detected on their system.
In a statement, RCBC said, Chan’s account “was compromised outside of the bank's system.”
"When a client gives their account information, password or one-time passwords, they are giving access to their accounts. RCBC constantly reminds its clients should never be shared with anyone," the bank said.
NBI Cybercrime Division chief Cris Paz reminded the public to remain vigilant against crimes, especially during the Holiday Season.
#DailyGuardian

item.title:
SURVIVAL AGAINST ALL ODDS
I withdraw my last allowance from an RCBC ATM in Silang, Cavite to buy a birthday cake. Malas namang lumabas na ang receipt and the amount was charged against my account but there was no money released. I tried once but not sufficient coz deducted na. Haha. There were three other ATMs and i tried. Insufficient! So l left heading home without that cake. And it was Sunday, so i cannot visit RCBC and LBP branches to file a complaint. Too bad, the following day i need to travel to Bataan for a CES Activity and travel back to Silang at night so that early Tuesday i could go to Tagaytay branches of the two banks. OMG! It was signal #1 and it was 1pm when heavy rains stopped. I cannot imagine to be in three distant places within 30hours just because of inefficiency of ATMs. And the refund? Well, after two weeks. Haha.
I head back home Wednesday with that horrifying air turbulence over the mountains of Panay! The captain seemed absent when lessons about flying in stormy skies were delivered. Or was he sleepy?
So, twice i survived! With no extra money and that horrible flight!
Lesson 1: Put up your own ATM for efficient transaction.
Lesson 2: Fly your own plane to choose the safer route.
Hehehe.
